darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
Usage: mcp-slim-guard [options] [command]

MCP context compression runtime — compress what agents see, preserve what tools
do

Options:
  -V, --version       output the version number
  -h, --help          display help for command

Commands:
  plan [options]      Generate a Host configuration plan without writing it
  install [options]   Apply one bounded Host configuration transaction with a
                      pre-write backup
  rollback [options]  Restore the recorded Host configuration if it has not
                      changed
  analyze             Inspect an MCP catalog without changing configuration or
                      invoking Tools
  profile [options]   Read bounded runtime delivery evidence without invoking
                      Tools
  init [options]      Auto-discover MCP config and generate mcp-slim-guard.yml
  start [options]     Start the guard proxy
  status              Show resolved configuration
  doctor              Diagnose upstream server connectivity and config validity
  validate            Dry-run: check which tools would be allowed/blocked by
                      current policies
  log [options]       View audit log
  uninit [options]    Remove mcp-slim-guard config and cleanup
  help [command]      display help for command
